name: QUALIFY
sql: SELECT 1 AS v QUALIFY row_number() OVER (ORDER BY 1)=1

name: TRY_CAST
sql: SELECT TRY_CAST('x' AS INT) AS v

name: LISTAGG
sql: SELECT LISTAGG(x,',') AS v FROM (SELECT 'a' x UNION ALL SELECT 'b')

name: LISTAGG WITHIN GROUP
sql: SELECT LISTAGG(x,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) AS v FROM (SELECT 'a' x)

name: NUMBER(38,2)
sql: SELECT CAST(1 AS NUMBER(38,2)) AS v

name: VARCHAR(n)
sql: SELECT CAST('a' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS v

name: GROUP BY position
sql: SELECT a AS v FROM (SELECT 1 a) GROUP BY 1

name: FLATTEN
sql: SELECT value AS v FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(input=>[1,2])) LIMIT 1

name: PERCENTILE_CONT
sql: SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY 1) AS v

name: TOP n
sql: SELECT TOP 1 v FROM (SELECT 1 AS v)

name: QUALIFY+PARTITION
sql: SELECT 1 AS v QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY 1)=1

name: LATERAL FLATTEN
sql: SELECT f.value AS v FROM (SELECT [1,2] AS arr) t, LATERAL FLATTEN(input=>arr) f LIMIT 1

name: MINUS
sql: SELECT 1 AS v MINUS SELECT 2 AS v

name: IS DISTINCT FROM
sql: SELECT 1 IS DISTINCT FROM NULL AS v
